description: This file implements the WaylandServer class, which manages the lifecycle and event loop of a Wayland display server, including socket creation, initialization, and cleanup, as well as setting callbacks for frame and display events.

classes.name: WaylandServer
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle of a Wayland display server, including socket setup, event loop, and cleanup.

classes.name: internal::WaylandServerState
classes.description: A struct holding the internal state of the WaylandServer, including the display pointer and surfaces.

methods.name: WaylandServer
methods.description: Constructor that starts the server thread and waits until the server is ready.

methods.name: ~WaylandServer
methods.description: Destructor that terminates the display and joins the server thread.

methods.name: ServerLoop
methods.description: Main loop that initializes the display, sets up interfaces, and runs the Wayland display event loop.

methods.name: SetFrameCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for frame events.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for display events.
